Image-model bake-off — resolution & quality on real paper prompts

Curated current models (old variants dropped) via OpenRouter's /api/v1/images endpoint. Reference (blue outline) = our actual native gemini-3-pro pipeline output.

Which models deliver 4K when asked

Resolution and aspect are separate axes. The dedicated images endpoint takes a resolution tier ("512"/"1K"/"2K"/"4K") and a size shorthand (tier or explicit pixels). The right lever is provider-specific — Gemini/Seedream/Riverflow honor resolution:"4K"; GPT Image 2 needs explicit size:"3840x2160"; the rest can't reach 4K by any param.

Bottom line: five models give true 4K — Nano Banana Pro 3 & Nano Banana 2 (5504×3072, the highest), Seedream 4.5, Riverflow V2.5 Pro, and GPT Image 2 (explicit-pixel size only). Our own default flash model already does 4K, so "gemini-3-pro not doing 4K" was a native-path/config issue, not a model limit. FLUX caps at 2K, Grok at ~2.8K, Microsoft & Krea at ~1.4K.

Aspect ratio

Separate from resolution. Gemini honors the requested aspect and is perfectly consistent. On the older chat endpoint, GPT-image and Nano Banana 1 forced 1024² square; the dedicated images endpoint fixes this by taking an explicit aspect_ratio (1:1 / 16:9 / 4:3 / 3:4). Note it does not accept 21:9, so ultra-wide hero diagrams fall back to 16:9.

All four/five boxes converge with arrows into a final dark-blue box on the far right: 'Final Answer + Accuracy / Detection Metrics'. Small caption at the bottom: 'Evaluated on anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5, openai/gpt-4o-mini, meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct, 200 problems each, temperature 0.0'.

P3: Nucleus-Satellite to Prolog Clause Mapping Table spec 21:9

show prompt
Table format, 4 columns × 7 rows (including header). Column headers: 'RST Relation Type', 'Nucleus Role', 'Satellite Role', 'Prolog Template'. Row 1 (CONDITION): nucleus='Consequent', satellite='Condition (premise)', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {satellite}({X}).'. Row 2 (EVIDENCE): nucleus='Conclusion', satellite='Justification (proof)', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {satellite}({X}).'. Row 3 (CAUSE): nucleus='Result/Effect', satellite='Cause (antecedent)', template='{result}({X}) :- {cause}({X}), temporal_order.'. Row 4 (CONCESSION): nucleus='Main (despite satellite)', satellite='Conceding fact', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {base}({X}), \+ {satellite}({X}).'. Row 5 (ELABORATION): nucleus='Primary', satellite='Detail/Adjunct', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {satellite}({X}). OR independent facts.'. Row 6 (ENABLEMENT): nucleus='Enabled action', satellite='Enabling precondition', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {enabler}({X}), precondition_met({X}).'. Row 7 (EXPLANATION): nucleus='Event/fact', satellite='Reason/cause', template='{nucleus}({X}) :- {explanation}({X}).'. Table headers bold, centered. Rows alternating light gray/white background. Font: monospace for templates, sans-serif for text.
